name: forge-agent
description: Forge — AI coding agent CLI with harness (Stop/goal/ULW), production reliability (Retry-After, abortable/empty-SSE streams, JSON repair, doom-loop, error-streak, apply_patch, overflow recovery, session fork/export/import/auto-resume, metrics.jsonl, OAuth refresh), Bar A daily-driver safety, and quality tools

scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run smoke
scripts.smoke: npm run build && node dist/cli.js --version && (node dist/cli.js doctor --json >/dev/null || true) && node dist/cli.js completion bash >/dev/null && node dist/cli.js models --json >/dev/null && node dist/cli.js prune-tool-output --json >/dev/null && node dist/cli.js prune-metrics --json >/dev/null
